desc:
🌈Welcome to Free UGC Avatar Glass Bridge!

🚶Cross the glass bridge and create your perfect avatar.

👑Choose faces, hairstyles, outfits, and accessories.
🔎Find the safe glass tiles.
⚠️Avoid the breaking glass.
🏆Reach the finish and choose an in-game reward.
👥Play and compete with friends.

The safe path changes during the round. Can you reach the finish?

⭐️Add the Game to favourite

✅Follow the Group for more updates
